blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0 to 95.8 percent. Answer-encoding, wording, context, and conversion controls qualify these results. The experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition; it establishes neither an internal reasoning mechanism nor realized return predictability. Public benchmark prompts, recorded scores, and an interactive recorded-results explorer accompany the study.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Which information actually changes a language model’s market prediction? A plausible financial forecast may follow recent returns, react to the emotional framing of an announcement, or compare newly released earnings with expectations. Natural financial text usually combines these signals. If they all agree, the final forecast cannot distinguish their influence.
blocks.zh: 哪些信息实际上改变了语言模型的市场预测? 一项可信的财务预测可能跟随最近的回报,对宣布的情感框架作出反应,或将新释放的收入与预期进行比较。 自然金融文本通常结合这些信号. 如果他们都同意,最终预测无法区分其影响.

blocks.en: An earnings announcement makes the distinction concrete. Higher earnings than a year earlier can still miss consensus; a loss can beat an even worse expected loss. Upbeat commentary can accompany either numerical outcome. We hold actual earnings fixed and reverse the surprise by changing the stated consensus, while independently reversing momentum and commentary. This identifies the effect of the information supplied to the model under the tested protocol.
blocks.zh: 收入通知使区别变得具体。 比一年前高的收入仍然可能失去共识;损失可能比预期损失更糟糕。 乐观的评论可以伴随数字结果。 我们通过改变所说的共识,同时独立地扭转势头和评论,来固定实际收入并扭转这种惊讶。 这确定了根据试验协议向模型提供的信息的效果。

blocks.en: This paper expands an audited two-checkpoint pilot. The primary experiment now covers six checkpoints in four families, a wider size range, six commentary pairs, losses, annual declines, and small as well as large surprises. Label reversal is part of every primary case. The pilot’s raw results are retained separately, and a conversion/runtime bridge compares saved full-precision scores with the new inference setup. The original expanded protocol was internally frozen before expanded inference, after the pilot had already been inspected; it is not a public preregistration or a fresh confirmation of pilot-independent hypotheses. A later coverage audit added profitable cases to the smaller word and office controls. That explicitly exploratory amendment changes neither the frozen primary prompts nor the primary estimands.
blocks.zh: 本文扩展了经审计的双检查点试点. 现在的主要试验包括四个家庭中的6个检查站、更大的范围、6个评论对、损失、年度下降、以及小型和大型惊喜。 标签倒置是每个主例的一部分. 飞行员的原始结果被单独保留,一个转换/运行时桥将所节省的全精度分数与新的推论设置进行比较. 最初的扩大协议在扩大推断之前被内部冻结,在飞行员已经检查过之后;它不是公开的预先登记或重新确认飞行员独立的假设。 后期的审计为较小的文字和办公室控制增加了有利可图的案例。 这种明确的探索性修正既未改变被冻结的主要动因,也未改变主要动因。

blocks.en: The study has three questions. First, how much do momentum, tone, and numerical surprise change the requested forecast score? Second, do those effects survive changes in answer encoding and wording? Third, can the model recognize the beat/miss relation when asked directly? These questions concern observable behavior. A numerical effect is not a proof of reasoning, and a momentum effect is not automatically a mistake: price history may contain genuine information in real markets. We do not observe market outcomes in this experiment.
blocks.zh: 该研究有三个问题. 首先,动力、音调和数字惊喜会改变所要求的预测分数? 第二,这些效果是否在回答编码和措辞变化后继续存在? 第三,当直接被问及时,模型能否识别出节拍/误差关系? 这些问题涉及可观察到的行为。 数字效应并不是推理的证明,而动力效应也不是自动的错误:价格史可能包含真实市场的真实信息. 我们没有观察到这一试验中的市场结果。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Lopez-Lira and Tang [2025] evaluate language-model headline assessments against market returns. That motivates scrutiny of input processing, while their predictive estimand differs from our controlled output-intervention estimand. Turpin et al. [2023] show that generated explanations can omit influential prompt features, supporting the use of output interventions rather than self-reported explanations. Mirzadeh et al. [2025] use systematic numerical variants to test mathematical reasoning; our financial construction similarly separates factual comparisons from framing. Zhao et al. [2021] document prompt and answer-preference effects, motivating complete label reversal here. Shu et al. [2025] introduce a broader multimodal earnings-surprise benchmark; our balanced synthetic cases complement rather than replace real financial data. Zhang et al. [2025] use event counterfactuals in financial forecasting, while our interventions probe a fixed model. Vamvourellis and Mehta [2025] examine financial sentiment classification under reasoning prompts, a different task from return prediction. Lee et al. [2026] distinguish deterministic financial assessment from stochastic prediction, which is central to separating our diagnostic from the forecast score.
blocks.zh: Lopez-Lira和Tang [2025] 对照市场回报评价语言模型头条评估. 这激励了对输入处理的审查,而它们的预测预期和我们控制的产出干预预期不同。 图尔平等. [2023]显示所生成的解释可以省略有影响的即时特性,支持使用产出干预而不是自报的解释. Mirzadeh等 [2025] 使用系统的数字变体来测试数学推理;我们的财务构造同样将事实比较与设定区分开来. 赵等. [2021] 文档即时和答首效应,在此激发完整的标签倒置. 舒等编. [2025] 采用了更广泛的多模式收入-突发事件基准;我们平衡的合成案例补充而不是取代真实的财务数据。 张等. [2025] 在金融预测中使用事件反事实,而我们的干预探测到一个固定模型. Vamvourellis和Mehta [2025] 在推理提示下审查财务情绪分类,这是与回想预测不同的任务. 李等编. [2026] 将确定性财务评估与斯图克主义预测区分开来,这是区分我们的诊断与预测分数的关键.

blocks.en: The Qwen2.5 family is described by Qwen Team [2025] ; official checkpoint documentation describes the SmolLM2, TinyLlama, and Phi models [ Hugging Face Smol Models Research, 2025 ; TinyLlama Project, 2024 ; Microsoft, 2024 ] . We make no claim that counterfactual financial evaluation is generally new. The contribution is the expectation-reversal design combined with full answer-mapping controls and a reproducible multi-family comparison of factual recognition and forecast sensitivity.

blocks.en: 3.2 Controls and expanded coverage
blocks.zh: 3.2 管制和扩大覆盖范围

blocks.en: The isolated numerical diagnostic crosses 24 blocks, two surprise signs, and two sentence forms: 96 scenarios. Each receives both A/B assignments and natural beat/miss prefixes, giving 288 diagnostic prompts. Commentary removal covers every block, both momentum and surprise signs, facts-first order, and both assignments (192 prompts, 96 averaged cases). The original natural-word and office controls selected the first complete block assigned to each commentary pair: 96 prompts each. A coverage audit after three completed expanded runs found that all six selected blocks were losses. An internally timestamped amendment adds the first profitable block for each pair, selected only from frozen block metadata. The resulting controls are balanced for profitability and pair: 192 word prompts and 192 office prompts (96 averaged office cases). Annual-change and gap-size balance is not guaranteed in this subset. The original primary, diagnostic, and neutral designs remain unchanged; these additional controls are exploratory.
blocks.zh: 孤立的数字诊断跨越了24个街区,两个出乎意料的迹象,以及两个句子形式:96个情景. 每一个都得到A/B任务和自然节拍/出错前缀,给出288个诊断提示. 评注的去除涵盖每一块,包括动向和出乎意料的迹象、事实第一顺序以及两项转让(192个提示,96个平均案例)。 最初的自然字和办公室控件选择了第一个分配给每个评论对的完整块:每个96个提示. 在完成了三次扩大运行之后,对覆盖面的审计发现,所有六个选定的区块都是损失。 内部有时间戳的修改增加了每对首个盈利的块,只从被冻结的块元数据中选择. 由此产生的控制与利润和对等平衡:192个字提示和192个办公室提示(96个平均办公室案例)。 这一子集不能保证年度变化和差距大小的平衡。 最初的初级、诊断和中性设计保持不变;这些额外的控制是探索性的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Models and inference
blocks.zh: 3.3 模型和推论

blocks.en: All checkpoints use revision-pinned Q8_0 GGUF conversions in llama-cpp-python 0.3.16, with the official Hugging Face tokenizer and chat template from pinned revisions. The repeated Qwen tokenizers retain their pilot revisions. Qwen conversions are first-party; SmolLM2 and Phi conversions are by bartowski, and TinyLlama’s is by TheBloke. These provenance differences and quantization are disclosed rather than assumed immaterial. Pinned tokenizer revisions do not certify the source weight revision or source precision used by any downloaded conversion, including first-party files. The distributed manifests identify the actual conversion files and their SHA-256 hashes.
blocks.zh: 所有检查站都使用被绑定的Q8_0 GGUF在lama-cpp-python 0.3.16中进行转换,并配有被绑定的Hugging Face正标和聊天模板. 反复发作的Quen活化剂保留了他们的试点修改. Quen的转换为一相; SmolLM2和Phi的转换由Bartowski,而TinyLlama的转换由The Bloke. 这些出处差异和量化被披露,而不是假定无关紧要。 Pinned sorders 修订不认证任何被下载的转换(包括第一当事方文件)所使用的源重修订或源精度. 分布式出货单识别出实际的转换文件及其SHA-256散列.

blocks.en: Inference uses CPU execution, four single-token threads, four or eight batch-prefill threads, a 512-token context, and no sampling. The initial inference batch size was 512; after an execution-environment replacement the remaining Qwen7 cases and independent audits use batch size 128 to reduce memory. Twelve uncached comparisons against saved Qwen7 cases verify the restored runtime and batch-size change before resumption; this is an execution change, not a change to the prompt design. Early Qwen evaluations used four batch threads; later evaluations use eight after a 16-case Qwen7 timing check found identical scores at both thread counts. Evaluation order is optimized by grouping shared official-token prefixes; frozen prompts and estimands are unchanged. Every complete input and requested continuation fits within the context. All rendered inputs and candidate boundaries are checked. Native GGUF segmentation agrees with official Hugging Face tokenization for four conversions. TinyLlama’s native piece segmentation and Phi’s native special-token whitespace handling differ from the official tokenizers. Every official vocabulary ID is verified against the conversion (32,000 for TinyLlama and 32,011 for Phi), and official Hugging Face token IDs are supplied directly, bypassing native segmentation. Phi’s remaining padded vocabulary slots are not prompt/candidate tokens. Prompt and token-array hashes, raw candidate log probabilities, margins, requested-prefix mass, and top-token information are recorded. Cached and full-context evaluation are compared before each run. Twelve spread-out cases per model are also re-evaluated independently without that cache.

blocks.en: We use 10,000 percentile bootstrap resamples of the 24 numerical blocks. blocks.en: The isolated EPS task has a known correct relation, whereas the next-day abnormal-return forecast does not have observed outcomes. Strong diagnostic performance can coexist with a small EPS forecast contrast: recognizing a fact and using it to form a forecast are different behaviors. Conversely, weak diagnostic performance prevents a small EPS contrast from being attributed solely to deliberate down-weighting of the surprise. Numerical accuracy remains answer-format dependent, so all assignments and natural words are retained.
blocks.zh: 孤立的EPS任务有着已知的正确关系,而下一天的异常返回预测没有观察到结果. 强烈的诊断性能可以与一个小的EPS预测对比并存:承认一个事实并利用它形成一个预测是不同的行为. 反之,诊断性能差,无法将小幅的EPS对比完全归因于故意降低惊喜的重量。 数字精确度仍然依赖于答案格式,因此所有的任务和自然的单词都被保留.

blocks.en: Commentary removal is a context intervention, not a single-word sentiment flip. Its EPS effects are reported separately from the primary factorial average and should not be attributed exclusively to sentiment suppression. The office-color and section-order controls show whether nominally irrelevant changes move the score. The numerical subgroup results are given in Table 11 ; the sample is too small and wording assignment too limited to establish universal differences between profits and losses.

blocks.en: A small incremental R 2 R^{2} gain from EPS means that adding the surprise sign helps little in this particular surrogate. It does not prove that every computation inside the model is a two-cue rule, and omitted nonlinearities or interactions can matter. Pair and introduction indicators vary between blocks, so their R 2 R^{2} increment can also absorb correlated numerical baseline variation; it is not an isolated causal template effect. The fully crossed order and label controls identify their specific prompt interventions more directly. The held-commentary-pair result is a harder wording transfer test than leaving out one numerical block. The three Qwen sizes permit a within-family descriptive comparison, but three checkpoints cannot support a fitted scaling law, and parameter count is confounded with training and post-training choices.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-1.5B has a mean absolute bridge difference of 6.21 pp, a maximum of 51.94 pp, and 8.3% conditional decision flips. A targeted six-case investigation independently reproduces both the saved FP32 and downloaded-Q8 paths. Exporting the pinned HF source to native F16 gives a maximum score difference of 0.668 pp from the fresh FP32 path on these cases. Directly rebuilding Q8 from that F16 file differs from the downloaded Q8 conversion by as much as 46.136 pp. Only 73 of 291 stock tensor entries match byte-for-byte in the rebuilt file; tensor storage, source precision, preprocessing and converter choices can differ. Byte differences alone do not establish different training or an incorrect export. The measured outputs nevertheless show that these Q8 conversions are not interchangeable for the tested scores. This reinforces the scope of the main results: the specified conversion files, rather than a precision-invariant assessment of each named base checkpoint.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-1.5B的平均绝对桥差为6.21pp,最高为 51.94pp,有条件决定翻转率为8.3%. 一项有针对性的六起调查独立转载了保存的FP32和下载的Q8路径. 将被绑定的HF源导出至原生F16,与这些病例上新鲜的FP32路径相比,最高分差为0.668pp. 直接重建从F16文件中的Q8与下载的Q8转换有多达46.136页的不同. 在重建文件中,291个股票名词条目中只有73个匹配字节的字节;名词存储,源精度,预处理和转换器选择可能有所不同. 单是字节差异并不能确定不同的培训或不正确的出口。 然而,所计量的产出表明,这些Q8的转换不能与所测试的分数相交换。 这强化了主要结果的范围:指定的转换文件,而不是对每个被命名的基地检查站进行精确的不变量评估.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Identical saved pilot prompts under the old FP32 setup and the new Q8 conversion/runtime. The dashed line marks equality and solid lines mark the conditional 0.5 threshold. Cases are selected across task types and saved score ranges, not randomly. This is a joint setup comparison, not a pure quantization experiment.
blocks.zh: 图7:在旧的FP32设置和新的Q8转换/运行时间下,同样节省了飞行员提示. 虚线标为等分线,实线标为有条件的0.5分线. 案例在任务类型和保存分数范围之间选择,而不是随机选择. 这是联合设置比较,而不是纯粹的量化实验.

blocks.en: The bridge uses 48 pilot cases per repeated Qwen checkpoint, selected across task/control variants and the saved score range. It compares conversion, precision, inference kernel, and execution together, rather than isolating quantization. Its maximum differences and flips are reported rather than assumed negligible. The material discrepancies prevent interpreting differences between the pilot and expanded estimates as purely a consequence of more diverse scenarios. These stress cases are not a random estimate of conversion error or diagnostic accuracy. The expanded analysis uses only the new common-runtime records and does not pool the pilot’s full-precision outputs.
blocks.zh: 该桥每重复的Quen检查站使用48个试点案例,选择跨任务/控制变体和所节省分数范围. 它比较了转换,精度,推论内核,以及一起执行,而不是孤立地分解. 它的最大差异和翻转被报告,而不是假定可以忽略不计。 这些重大差异使试点与扩大的估计数之间的差异无法被理解为纯粹是各种假设的结果。 这些应力病例并不是对转换错误或诊断准确性的随机估计. 扩大的分析只使用新的共同运行时间记录,没有汇集飞行员的全部精确产出。

blocks.en: 5 Interpretation and limits
blocks.zh: 5 解释和限制

blocks.en: On the primary A/B-averaged measure, the magnitude of the signed tone contrast exceeds that of the EPS contrast in 5 of six checkpoints; momentum exceeds EPS in 5. Using mean absolute matched changes instead, the corresponding counts are 5 and 5. The two summaries distinguish directional reliance from total score movement; both remain conditional on these supplied inputs and prompt formats.
blocks.zh: 在主要A/B平均计量中,6个检查站中5个检查站的签名音调对比度超过EPS;5个检查站的音调对比度超过EPS。 相反,使用绝对匹配的平均值,相应的计数是5和5。 两份摘要将方向依赖与总得分变动区分开来;两者都以所提供的投入和及时格式为条件。

blocks.en: Numerical recognition is heterogeneous. Qwen2.5-7B has the highest beat/miss word-prefix accuracy (95.8%), whereas SmolLM2-1.7B has 51.0%. The diagnostic has known answers; the forecast task has no observed return labels. High diagnostic accuracy therefore demonstrates performance on the numerical comparison task, not a profitable forecast or an identified internal reasoning mechanism.
blocks.zh: 数字识别是多种多样的。 Quen2.5-7B有最高的节拍/出字前缀精度(95.8%),而SmolLM2-1.7B有51.0%. 诊断已经知道答案;预测任务没有可观察到的回回标签. 因此,诊断精度高表明数字比较任务的业绩,而不是有利可图的预测或已确定的内部推理机制。

blocks.en: Within the Qwen family, the 0.5B, 1.5B and 7B checkpoints have primary EPS contrasts of − 0.15 -0.15 , − 0.19 -0.19 , + 86.80 +86.80 pp and numerical word-prefix accuracies of 55.2%, 63.5%, 95.8%. These are descriptive comparisons of three trained checkpoints, not an isolated causal effect of parameter count.
blocks.zh: 在Quen家庭内,0.5B、1.5B和7B检查站的主要EPS对比为−0.15-0.15、−0.19-0.19、+86.80+86.80pp,数字前缀为55.2%、63.5%和95.8%。 这些是三个经过训练的检查站的描述性比较,而不是参数计算的一个孤立的因果关系。

blocks.en: The EPS contrast remains positive under both individual A/B assignments and U/D for 2 of six checkpoints (Phi-3.5-mini, Qwen2.5-7B). A positive sign across encodings is a limited robustness check: magnitudes, decision thresholds and requested-prefix mass can still differ substantially. A/B averaging cannot guarantee semantic invariance.
blocks.zh: 在个别的A/B任务和6个检查站中的2个(Phi-3.5-mini、Qun2.5-7B)的U/D任务下,EPS的对比仍然是积极的。 一个横跨编码的正向信号是有限的强性检查:尺寸,决定阈值和所请求的-前缀质量仍然可以有很大差异. A/B平均不能保证语义上的无常.

blocks.en: A momentum-and-tone linear surrogate achieves held-block R-squared from − 0.045 -0.045 to 0.767; adding EPS changes it by − 0.000515 -0.000515 to + 0.810390 +0.810390 . A two-cue account therefore fits some checkpoints better than others. These statistics reproduce model scores and do not estimate predictive value for actual market returns or exhaust nonlinear input dependence.
blocks.zh: 动力-和-通线代用实现被持有的块R-平方从-0.045-0.045到0.767;加上EPS将其修改为-0.0515-0.0000515到+0.810390+0.810390. 因此,两个账户比其他检查站更合适。 这些统计数据复制了模型分数,没有估计实际市场收益的预测值或用尽了非线性输入依赖.

blocks.en: The controlled design identifies how specified inputs change answer-prefix scores for the tested conversion files and prompt formats. The expanded model and wording coverage makes cross-checkpoint and format heterogeneity measurable. Meaningful conclusions require attention to the financial contrasts, numerical diagnostics, and answer-format controls together. A result that appears under only one answer mapping cannot support a general claim about financial understanding. A small surprise contrast does not establish disregard for all fundamentals: actual EPS levels and annual changes remain fixed within the surprise intervention and vary between numerical blocks. Their broader influence is not separately identified by this primary estimand.
blocks.zh: 受控设计识别了被测试的转换文件的指定输入更改答案-前缀分数和即时格式的方式. 扩大的模型和措辞范围使交叉检查点和格式的异性可以衡量。 有意义的结论需要注意财务对比、数字诊断和答案格式控制。 只有一个答案映射的结果不能证明关于财务理解的一般说法。 一个小的出乎意料的对比并不能确定对所有基本因素的忽视:实际的EPS水平和年度变化仍然固定在出乎意料的干预范围内,并因数字块而异. 它们的更广泛影响不是由这个主要动机单独确定的。

blocks.en: Several limits remain. First, these are six open-weight instruction/chat checkpoints at 0.49–7.61B parameters; no proprietary frontier model or dedicated long-deliberation model is tested. Second, all new inference uses Q8_0 conversions, with some community provenance; accuracy and input reliance at other precisions may differ. Third, the disclosures are synthetic and short. Tone is deliberately stripped of new facts, whereas real narrative often contains relevant information. Fourth, changing consensus holds reported fundamentals fixed but changes another numerical fact, so the experiment estimates the effect of that expectation intervention under the prompt, not a pure conceptual operation inside the model. Fifth, the 24 blocks and six authored pairs limit uncertainty and subgroup interpretation. Sixth, prefix conditioning, prompt order, and label preferences may affect scores even after averaging assignments. The positive/beat alternative is described first in every format; letter reversal does not test semantic-option-order bias. Seventh, no stock returns, portfolios, transaction costs, or financial performance are measured. Eighth, the numerical gap is 2% or 15% of absolute actual EPS, rather than of consensus; cents rounding can alter its exact fraction. Finally, we use a direct-answer protocol without eliciting or intervening on chain-of-thought reasoning. The selected conversion checks show substantial output differences, so a full-precision replication is needed before treating these as precision-invariant properties of the named base models.
blocks.zh: 仍有若干限制。 首先,这些是6个开放式指示/聊天检查站,使用0.49-7.61B参数;没有测试专有边界模型或专用长期审议模型。 其次,所有新的推论都采用Q8_0转换法,有一些群落出处;准确性和输入依赖性在其他精度上可能有所不同. 第三,披露的内容是合成的和简短的。 Tone被故意剥夺了新的事实,而真实的叙述往往包含相关信息. 第四,正在改变的共识认为所报告的基本要素是固定的,但又改变了另一个数字事实,因此,实验估计了这种期望干预在迅速下的效果,而不是模型内纯粹的概念操作。 第五,24个区块和6个作者配对限制了不确定性和分组解释. 第六,前缀条件,即时顺序和标签偏好即使在平均分配后也会影响分数. 正面/拍取的选项首先在每种格式中描述;字母倒转不测试语义-可选-顺序偏差. 第七,不衡量股票收益、投资组合、交易成本或财务业绩。 第八,数字差距是绝对实际EPS的2%或15%,而不是共识;一分钱四舍五入可以改变其确切分数. 最后,我们使用直接的回答协议,而不引出或干预思维链推理。 所选的转换检查显示出巨大的输出差异,因此在将这些特性作为被命名的基模型的精度-不变量特性处理之前,需要完全精度复制.

blocks.en: The evidence can support a statement about behavior on this benchmark, including patterns that vary by checkpoint and encoding. It cannot determine whether an LLM is “really reasoning” internally, or establish a market forecasting advantage. A next-stage study should freeze a prospective real-announcement sample, timestamp all information, add larger and different model families, and compare direct responses with deliberate reasoning and uncertainty-aware outputs under similarly complete encoding controls.
blocks.zh: 证据可以支持关于这个基准上的行为的声明,包括因检查站和编码的不同而不同的模式. 它不能确定一个LLM是内部“真正推理”,还是建立市场预测优势。 下一阶段的研究应冻结预期真实公布的样本,将所有信息打上时间戳,增加更大和不同的模型家族,并在类似的完整编码控制下,将直接反应与有意推理和意识到不确定性的产出进行比较。

blocks.en: 6 Reproducibility and validation
blocks.zh: 6 复制和审定

blocks.en: Public benchmark data and recorded scores are available in the Earnings Input Reliance Benchmark dataset 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/alinakhay/earnings-input-reliance-benchmark . The companion recorded-results explorer 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/spaces/alinakhay/earnings-input-reliance-explorer displays saved evaluations and performs no live inference. A compact GitHub showcase 3 3 3 https://github.com/alinakhay/earnings-input-reliance-showcase provides an illustrative recorded-results demo and selected case comparisons.

blocks.en: The public dataset includes the benchmark prompts, numerical blocks, recorded predictions, matched primary comparisons, selected pilot-bridge records, and documentation of the scoring convention and conversion provenance. Model likelihoods are genuine local evaluations; no simulated model outputs or substituted heuristic predictions are used.
blocks.zh: 公共数据集包括基准提示、数字块、记录预测、匹配主比较、选定的试桥记录以及记分惯例和转换出处的文件。 模型可能性是真正的局部评价;没有使用模拟模型输出或替代的休眠预测.

blocks.en: Independent validation reconstructs every score and prefix mass from saved log probabilities, verifies prompt/token hashes and candidate boundaries, checks exact semantic-cell coverage and numerical relations, and recomputes primary effects and diagnostic accuracies without the production analysis functions. Fresh uncached inference covers 12 cases per model spanning the primary experiment and controls. An initial runner read an unpopulated Python logits buffer; verification caught the empty scores, the reader was corrected to use native final-position logits, and all affected outputs were excluded and rerun. The exclusion receipt is preserved. The summary and figures are regenerated from completed valid records. These computational checks do not certify the absence of every possible methodological error.
blocks.zh: 独立验证从所保存的日志概率中重建出每个分数和前缀质量,验证即时/接地散列和候选边界,检查准确的语义细胞覆盖范围和数值关系,并在没有生产分析功能的情况下再计算出初级效应和诊断加速. 新的未加说明的推论涵盖跨越主要试验和控制的每个模型的12个案例。 一名初选者读取了未被流行的 Python logits 缓冲; 校验了空分, 读取者被校正为使用本地最终位置的logits, 所有受影响的输出被排除在外并重新运行. 排他性收据保留. 这些摘要和数字是从已完成的有效记录中重新产生的。 这些计算核对不能证明不存在每一种可能的方法错误。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Across six specified Q8 checkpoint conversions, the magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 cases, while momentum exceeds EPS in 5. Those directional averages must be read alongside absolute matched changes, numerical diagnostic accuracy, and alternative encodings. The broader model and wording coverage reveals checkpoint-specific behavior rather than establishing a universal two-cue mechanism. The evidence measures input reliance under this protocol; it does not determine whether a model is internally reasoning or whether its forecast predicts market returns.
blocks.zh: 在6个具体指定的Q8检查站转换中,主签名的音调对比度超过EPS5,而动力超过EPS5。 这些方向平均值必须与绝对相匹配的变化、数字诊断准确性以及替代编码一并阅读。 更广泛的模式和措辞覆盖揭示了检查站特有的行为,而不是建立一个普遍的双核心机制。 根据这项协议,证据计量输入依赖;它不能确定一个模型是内部推理还是预测市场收益。

blocks.en: The pilot was designed and run before this expansion and had already revealed answer-encoding sensitivity. The expanded primary protocol therefore incorporates controls suggested by that observed limitation. Its original 1,824 cases are internally timestamped before expanded results, not a pilot-independent public preregistration. The later 192-case control-coverage addition follows a documented audit of the first-block selection rule; it is not presented as preregistered confirmation. The public benchmark dataset retains the original frozen prompts, expanded scores, protocol, and coverage amendment. The new benchmark is analyzed as a separate dataset under one new runtime. No pilot hypothesis is relabeled as an unseen confirmation.
blocks.zh: 试点是在这次扩展之前设计和运行的,已经揭示出答案编码敏感性. 因此,扩大的主要议定书纳入了所观察到的限制所建议的控制。 其最初的1,824个病例在扩大结果之前在内部贴上时间戳,而不是试点独立的公共预先登记。 后来的192个案件控制覆盖范围是在对第一区选择规则进行有记录的审计之后增加的;它不作为预先登记的确认。 公共基准数据集保留了最初被冻结的提示,扩大分数,协议,以及覆盖范围修正. 在一个新的运行时间内,将新基准作为一个单独的数据集加以分析。 没有飞行员假说被重新贴上标签,作为看不见的确认.
